title: 第11章 深入合作第12章 混元锁阳诀
slug: 修真废柴我的系统有点猛
lines: 他低头，目光不由自主地扫过洛彦那因激动而微微起伏的饱满胸脯，领口深处若隐若现的沟壑。
再看看脑海中系统面板那仅剩的3点阴阳值……
一个大胆的想法猛的窜了上来！
姚德龙随即抓住洛彦那饱满如玉汁的纤手，目光毫不掩饰的在其身上打转！
洛彦何等精明？姚德龙那赤裸裸的眼神在她身上肆无忌惮地扫视，她岂能不知？
心中瞬间掠过一丝厌恶和鄙夷。
一个半截身子都入土的老东西，也敢对她起这等龌龊心思？！
但……目光落回手中那枚蕴藏恐怖能量的“伪二阶暴灵丹”
上，
所有的厌恶都被巨大的利益强行压下。
一个坚定的想法在她脑中敲定。
必须留住他！
牢牢拴住这头会下金蛋的老鹅！
哪怕……付出点“代价”
她脸上笑容未变，甚至更加柔媚入骨，眼神却像淬了毒的蜜糖。
她伸出青葱玉指，在姚德龙枯瘦的掌心暧昧的划着，声音压得极低，带着勾人的语气：
“姚哥哥~你看这里人多眼杂的……
不如……我们去后面……慢慢谈？奴家……一定让哥哥满意……”
姚德龙喉结剧烈滚动了一下，眼中燃起熊熊烈焰：
后面谈！
后面谈！”
万药斋后堂，一间布置得颇为雅致、点着暖色灯烛的静室。
石门刚一关上，洛彦脸上的媚笑瞬间收敛了几分，眼中闪过一丝决然和屈辱。
她背对着姚德龙，没有多余的言语，只是抬手，缓缓解开了腰间的丝绦。
薄纱长裙如失瀑般滑落，落在柔软的地毯之上。
充满成熟风韵、丰腴至极、堪称人间尤物的身躯，毫无保留地展现在摇曳的烛光下。
饱满傲人的峰峦，赫然挺立着。
纤细的腰肢之下，勾勒着惊心动魄的弧线。
修长笔直的双腿并拢，在烛光下泛着诱人的光泽。
她缓缓转过身，脸上异常的平静，但微微颤抖的睫羽和紧抿的唇瓣，暴露了她内心的不平静。
“姚哥哥……”
她的声音带着一丝不易察觉的沙哑，“来吧。”
姚德龙哪里还忍得住？低吼一声，如同扑食的饿狼般冲了上去！
一夜疯狂。
content_en:
He lowered his head and glanced involuntarily at Luo Yan's plump chest, which was rising slightly with excitement, and the looming ravine deep in his collar.
Look at the remaining 3 points of yin and yang on the system panel in my mind...
A bold idea suddenly came to mind!
Yao Delong immediately grabbed Luo Yan's slender hand that was as full as jade juice, and his eyes wandered over his body unabashedly!
How smart is Luo Yan? How could she not know that Yao Delong's naked eyes were scanning her body unscrupulously?
A trace of disgust and contempt flashed through his heart.
How dare an old man, half of his body buried in the ground, have such dirty thoughts towards her? !
But... his eyes fell back to the "pseudo-second-level violent spirit pill" that contained terrifying energy in his hand.
Up,
All disgust was forcibly suppressed by huge benefits.
A firm idea settled in her mind.
He must be kept!
Tie this old goose that can lay golden eggs tightly!
Even if...you pay a "price"
The smile on her face remained unchanged, and even became more charming, but her eyes were like poisoned honey.
She stretched out her green jade fingers and stroked ambiguously on Yao Delong's skinny palm, her voice was very low, with a seductive tone:
"Brother Yao~ Look at how many people are here...
Why don't we go to the back and talk slowly? The slave family...must satisfy my brother..."
Yao Delong's Adam's apple rolled violently, and his eyes ignited with blazing flames:
"Okay...okay!
Talk to you later!
Talk to you later! "
The back hall of Wanyao Zhai is a quiet room that is elegantly decorated and lit with warm-colored candles.
As soon as the stone door closed, the charming smile on Luo Yan's face instantly faded a bit, and a trace of determination and humiliation flashed in his eyes.
She turned her back to Yao Delong, without any unnecessary words, she just raised her hand and slowly untied the silk ribbon around her waist.
The long tulle skirt slipped down like a waterfall and landed on the soft carpet.
Full of mature charm, extremely plump, and a body that can be called a beauty in the world, it is displayed unreservedly under the flickering candlelight.
The plump and proud peaks stand proudly.
Under the slender waist, a thrilling arc is outlined.
The slender and straight legs were pressed together, glowing seductively in the candlelight.
She turned around slowly, her face unusually calm, but her slightly trembling eyelashes and pursed lips revealed her inner unrest.
"Brother Yao..."
Her voice had an imperceptible hoarseness, "Come on."
How could Yao Delong still hold back? With a low roar, he rushed forward like a hungry wolf pouncing on food!
A crazy night.
